direction.name: Procuresprint ledger (supplied design system; Data-Dense Professional posture)
direction.rationale: Who: procurement professionals and a supplier admin at a laptop for whole working days, plus the design-system owner reviewing. Primary object: a record in a workbench (purchase request, RFx event, contract, invoice); primary task: find the rows that need attention, open one, act. Density: balanced to dense (48 px rows, 36 px compact). Tone: precise, institutional, the brand's ledger: teal ink, ruled rows, tabular figures (index.html VOICE comment). The setup suggested Premium Storefront; it is ruled out because nothing here is browsed like a shop, a serif hero over photography would contradict the supplied system, and the design brief makes a supplied design system law. Runner-up Data-Dense Workbench from the library matches the posture and is what the supplied system already is, so the supplied system is used verbatim.
direction.signature: Deep teal rail (#04282E) carrying the white wordmark, against white ruled surfaces where every figure is tabular and every status is a labelled chip. Tiles that filter the table are the one interaction every workbench shares. Every buyer and supplier page opens with one teal page banner: breadcrumbs only on record pages, the page title in Gilroy medium, then approvals, notifications, an outlined Ask Me pill (buyer) and Refresh.
direction.runnerUp: Data-Dense Workbench (library) - identical posture, but would have invented tokens the supplied system already fixes
direction.templateOverride: ec-premium-storefront replaced by the supplied Procuresprint 2.0 system; recorded in product-blueprint.assumptions

typography.display: Gilroy (brand face), self-hosted from public/assets/fonts at 400, 500, 600, 700; fallback Plus Jakarta Sans
typography.mono: none; figures use Plus Jakarta Sans with tabular-nums (.num)
typography.loading: Gilroy files are served from public/assets/fonts through @font-face in tokens.css (licensed, supplied by the owner); Plus Jakarta Sans and Material Symbols Rounded load from Google Fonts per page

color.primary: #06424C brand teal (11.1:1 on white), from the Procuresprint logo
color.accent: #56B1A8 logo mint, used only in the wordmark and rail accent
color.source: assets/tokens.css comments; the file states each pair was contrast-checked to WCAG 2.2 AA

elevation: borders first; shadow only for sticky bars (e1), menus (e2) and dialogs or drawers (e3)

layout.archetype: workbench: page head, filter tiles, views, table, preview drawer; record: header, sections, side rail of actions; docs: sticky header, aside and specimens
layout.grid: sidebar 280px plus minmax(0,1fr); content 100% fluid, no max width
layout.navigation: left sidebar with grouped items (buyer) or four items (supplier); collapses to 64px; drawer under 905px; docs pages use a top bar with five links; page banner above content with the title and global actions
layout.primarySurface: the table of records that tiles and views filter

navigationModel: Left sidebar (buyer: Home plus eight groups; supplier: four items) rendered by ps.js from data-shell and data-module; design-system pages use a top documentation bar with Foundations, Components, Templates, Screens, Validation; buyer and supplier pages carry a 160px page banner (title left, global actions right) instead of a 56px top bar
density: comfortable 48px rows by default, compact 36px via data-density
responsiveStrategy: 100% fluid; breakpoints 600 (stack forms and page heads), 905 (sidebar becomes drawer, tables scroll in their box with sticky first column), 1240 and 1440 (more columns in grids); tested 320 to 2560 px by the source

imagery.sources: Material Symbols Rounded ligatures; the Procuresprint wordmark; no photography

motion: 120/200/280 ms with cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); sidebar collapse, drawer slide, toast; 0 ms under prefers-reduced-motion
components: Workbench tile that filters the table
Preview drawer with fields, timeline and primary action
patternsToUse: Dialog confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions
Page banner: one teal band with the page title and global actions; breadcrumbs shown only on record and form pages
patternsToAvoid: Premium Storefront moves: full-bleed hero, serif display, centred wordmark, cart drawer, product imagery (ruled out: this is a workbench, not a shop)
Decorative KPI tiles that do not filter anything (the habit prior for this domain)
Centred max-width page column with empty gutters
Adjacent cliche: generic teal SaaS dashboard with gradient cards and glassy panels
Icon-only buttons without a name; colour-only status
accessibility: Skip link first on every page
Dialogs and drawers trap focus and close on Escape
